headline: Approved accounts payable orders, including $1,166,021.88, and a Honda Odyssey minivan bid recommendation.
summary: Superintendent Joe Clark gave an update on the budget, with a preliminary FY28 budget due at the December 2 meeting. Staff also presented the state report card, which ranked the District first in math and postsecondary enrollment. Board members voted to monitor the District's equity report.
decisions: Approved A/P voucher checks, payroll warrants, and a Honda Odyssey minivan bid recommendation, with all in favor.
Approved November 4, 2026 meeting minutes and accounts payable orders over $50,000, including order #1218 for $1,166,021.88, with all in favor.
Approved monitoring Monitoring Report 2.11 Equity using the monitoring rubric, with all in favor.
Agreed to hold the Rigorous Academic Achievement monitoring report in December and move the Real-Life Skills report to April.
Agreed to discuss legislative outreach before starting it, with Tom Chittenden included in the conversation.

decision_evidence.quote: Approve A/P Voucher Checks to: Vermont Mechanical Inc. in the amount of $130,639.88... Hearing none, Dan Boyer moved to accept and Elissa Galvez seconded the motion. All were in favor; consent agenda was passed and items were approved.

Board meeting minutes of November 4, 2026... #1218 for $1,166,021.88... Elissa Galvez moved to accept and Michelle Boyer seconded the motion. All were in favor; consent agenda was passed and items were approved.

Emilee Hoffman called for a motion to monitor Monitor Report 2.11 Equity using the monitoring rubric included in the Board materials. Elissa Galvez moved, Dan Boyer seconded. No discussion. All in favor; motion passed.
The Board agreed to schedule the Rigorous Academic Achievement monitoring report for the first meeting in December and to move the Real-Life Skills monitoring report to April.
The Board discussed previously proposed outreach to local legislators and agreed that a discussion should take place before invitations or outreach are initiated.
